title: Tetum 1
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
You cannot enrol in this course if you are a native speaker of Tetum.
Students with previous experience of the language must sit a language proficiency assessment.

title: Tetum 2
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed TETM1002, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener.
